title: Alert setup progressive flow with rollout tie-ins and postmortem shortcuts
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Customers configuring alerts for LLM workloads struggle to connect alert triggers to deployment rollouts and post-incident artifacts. Currently alert creation is isolated from rollout policies (canary/A-B) and there is no easy way to attach postmortem or runbook links at creation time, which slows on-call handoffs and increases MTTR.

Goals: 1) Provide a progressive disclosure alert creation UI that starts simple but surfaces advanced rollout-aware options when relevant. 2) Let users associate a rollout policy and optionally attach postmortem/runbook templates and a postmortem link at alert creation time. 3) Improve on-call handoff speed by making post-incident links and suggested runbooks visible in alert cards and the incident timeline. 4) Keep the flow lightweight for self-serve users but powerful for SREs.

Proposal summary: Design a multi-step 'Alert + Rollout' composer that: (A) begins with a concise trigger and severity step, (B) shows SLO drift simulation and recommended thresholds, (C) offers an optional 'Tie to deployment' section where a user picks a rollout policy (canary, gradual, immediate) and defines automatic annotations (e.g., pause rollout on critical alert), (D) includes an 'Attach artifacts' step to add runbook templates, postmortem links, and a pointer to the relevant dashboard and trace. The composer will produce structured metadata saved with the alert so alert cards and the incident timeline can surface quick links and suggested next steps.

Constraints & non-goals: We will not implement backend rollout enforcement in this ticket; this is UX + metadata wiring only. Quantitative SLO tuning suggestions will be limited to simulated impact charts (no automated threshold tuning). Integration with RBAC and private deployments will be considered in a follow-up.

Deliverables: Figma prototype of the composer, high-fidelity alert card with rollout badge and artifact quick-links, acceptance criteria, and a developer handoff doc listing API/metadata keys and telemetry events.
acceptance_criteria: A Figma prototype exists for the 3-step composer: Trigger -> Rollout tie-ins -> Attach artifacts (link: figma.com/proto/alert-rollout-22011)
Prototype demonstrates SLO drift preview with sample traffic and shows recommended threshold adjustments
Alert metadata schema documented for ENG: keys for rollout_policy, artifact_links, suggested_runbook_id
Alert card UI mock surfaces rollout badge and shows a single-click 'Open postmortem' link when a postmortem URL is attached
On-call view (timeline) mock shows incident quick-links populated from alert metadata
Design reviewed and approved by PM (Marco Ruiz) and Eng owner (Leah Kim) with feedback addressed
notes: Trade-off: exposing rollout options increases cognitive load; we use progressive disclosure and smart defaults (default to 'no tie')
SLO simulation will use anonymized recent traffic buckets to show delta; engineering flagged potential perf cost — we will cache results for 5 minutes
We considered inline postmortem creation but opted for 'attach URL or template' to avoid committing to storage/workflows in this milestone
Accessibility: composer works end-to-end via keyboard and supports screen reader labels for rollout options and artifact attachments
